_doc: Training provenance of the game assets baked from the rock shape model (sibling of release_provenance.json, which
covers the terrain checkpoints; make_release.py does not read this file). Agent N, 2026-11-19, report:
Dev Working/docs/exp2-work/N-neural-rocks.md. Same rule as release_provenance.json: an asset may ship only if
every source in its lineage has allowed=true.

polyhaven_rocks.name: Poly Haven 3D models, category 'rocks' (37 assets, glTF geometry only)
polyhaven_rocks.verified: 2026-11-19: 'All assets (HDRIs, textures and 3D models)' are 'licensed as CC0'; 'You do not need to give credit'. Public API terms (github.com/Poly-Haven/Public-API): 'Free to use for any purpose, personal or commercial'.
polyhaven_rocks.attribution: not required; courtesy credit in ATTRIBUTION.md (Credits + 'Poly Haven 3D rock scans')
polyhaven_rocks.raw: /mnt/extrastorage/terrain-slm-data/raw/rocks (322 MB; per-asset provenance.json with authors, URLs, md5; sources.json sha256 0c58843a707584d60b655d169034c8d5fcf153c9f7a5ef98a3f4d710d5e65133)

ambientcg.name: ambientCG
ambientcg.why: checked 2026-11-19: the API lists no 3D models any more (every 'rock' asset is a 2D PBR material)

rocks-v1.how: python -m terrain_slm.rocks.dataset --device cuda:0: 40 closed rocks (winding-number voxelisation of 21 rock / rock-set assets) + 336 outcrops cut out of 9 coast / field scans (height field above a grey-opening ground, touching rocks split); dedupe + quality gate; 376 shapes, 64^3 occupancy + 32^3 TSDF.

rocks/rockvae_v1.evidence: python -m terrain_slm.rocks.train --out checkpoints/rocks/rockvae_v1 --steps 20000 --device cuda:0 (train.log line 1 = data sha256) then python -m terrain_slm.rocks.prior --vae checkpoints/rocks/rockvae_v1/last.pt --steps 30000 (latent flow stored in the same file, prior.log)

stonebreak-game/src/main/resources/world.how: python -m terrain_slm.rocks.bake --ckpt checkpoints/rocks/rockvae_v1/last.pt --out <that path> --bank-id 1 (seed 20261119; two bakes byte-identical)
